counting_policy.raw_observation_count: Number of tagged entries in PDF; not interview frequency.
counting_policy.primary_distinct_informants: Distinct A-E in evidence-linked observations, excluding Z and Samlet.
counting_policy.deduplication: Duplicate normalized wording should not inflate distinct claims.
counting_policy.missing: No mention does not imply 0 disagreement or absence.
counting_policy.weights: No numeric strength weights from clear/possible or tier.

matrix_interpretation.clear: En sentral funksjon som kommer eksplisitt frem i analysen eller utformingen av caset.
matrix_interpretation.possible: En sekundær funksjon gjennom andre paratekster, bestemte brukssituasjoner eller analytisk fortolkning.
matrix_interpretation.none: Ingen tilstrekkelig begrunnet forbindelse i denne analysen; ikke dokumentasjon på at forbindelsen er utelukket.

provenance_semantics.direct: Explicit relation in a paraphrased codebook statement; not verbatim interview transcript.
provenance_semantics.analytical: Researcher matrix or memo synthesis with sources.
provenance_semantics.exploratory: Unvalidated research hypothesis, not an empirical finding.

analysis_scope: User-supplied analytical synthesis, including theoretical and case-based qualifications; not a systematic measure of empirical strength.
